mcqs.q: Who authored the Long Telegram of 1946?
options: Dean Acheson
George Kennan
John Foster Dulles
Henry Kissinger

mcqs.q: What was the Western response to the 1948 Berlin Blockade?
options: Marshall Plan
Berlin Airlift
NATO invasion
Nuclear ultimatum

mcqs.q: How did the Bolsheviks seize power in October 1917?
options: The October Revolution was a mass popular uprising that stormed the Winter Palace.
William was Edward the Confessor's eldest son.
Trotsky's Military Revolutionary Committee coordinated a near-bloodless takeover of key buildings in Petrograd from a Provisional Government that had lost army and worker support.
The October Revolution overthrew the Tsar.

mcqs.q: Who were the main victims of the Great Terror?
options: Old Bolsheviks, the military officer corps, ethnic minorities, kulaks, ordinary citizens denounced by neighbours, and eventually the NKVD itself — millions arrested or shot, 1936-38.
Stalin only purged Jews and Ukrainians.
Stalin only purged senior Communist Party rivals.
William was Edward the Confessor's eldest son.

mcqs.q: Why did William of Normandy claim the English throne in 1066?
options: Stalin only purged Jews and Ukrainians.
William was Edward the Confessor's eldest son.
William invaded because he was the strongest king in Europe and wanted more land.
He claimed Edward the Confessor had promised him the throne in 1051 and that Harold Godwinson had sworn an oath to support that claim in 1064.
